scripts.text:
[Paltu]
If you bring me ^ff0000 50 Splendide Coins and the ingredients^000000, I'll make you a new hat in the same shape but worn as a ^ff0000Costume^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
如果你給我^ff0000 50枚輝煌領域金幣和材料^000000，我會為你製作一頂形狀相同、但作為^ff0000時裝^000000佩戴的新帽子。

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
Hmm, what was it...?
I think you adventurers call them ^0571B0Costumes^000000? right?
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
嗯，那個叫什麼來著...
我想你們冒險者叫它^0571B0時裝^000000？對吧？

scripts.text: Yes~ What do you need?
scripts.translation: 是的~ 你需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
I need 1 ^0571B0hat to replicate^000000 and
I need ^E1281E 4 Crystal Mirrors^000000 for magic resistance, ^E1281E 1 Fairy Magic Powder^000000 as the catalyst, and ^E1281E Emerald, Ruby, Sapphire, Topaz, and Zircon, 10 of each^000000, to be used for amplifying the magic power.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
我需要1頂^0571B0要複製的帽子^000000，
還需要^E1281E 4個水晶鏡子^000000用於魔法抗性，^E1281E 1份妖精魔法粉^000000作為催化劑，以及^E1281E 翡翠、紅寶石、藍寶石、黃玉和鋯石，各10個^000000，用於增強魔力。

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
There's quite a lot of ingredients, right? Well, I can't do anything about that. Dealing with magic power is not a joke.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
材料挺多的，對吧？我也沒辦法。處理魔力可不是開玩笑的。

scripts.text: Which hats can be replicated?
scripts.translation: 哪些帽子可以複製？

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
Oh! You're pretty sharp!
Almost forgot the most important thing.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
哦！你很敏銳嘛！
差點忘了最重要的事。

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
Hats that I can replicate are:
^0571B0Frog Hat, Romantic Flower, Magestic Goat, Blush, Valkyrie Helm, Deviruchi Hat, Assassin Mask, Elven Ears, Hahoe Mask, and Boys Cap^000000 a total of 10 types.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
我可以複製的帽子有：
^0571B0青蛙帽、花葉、山羊頭盔、腮紅、瓦爾基里頭盔、小惡魔帽、刺客口罩、妖精長耳朵飾、傳統面具和男孩帽^000000，總共10種。

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
What do you think? I'll make it happen as long as I have the ingredients and the compensation.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
你覺得怎麼樣？只要有材料和報酬，我就能做到。

scripts.text: I'll do it later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來。

scripts.text: Show me what you got!
scripts.translation: 讓我看看你有什麼！

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
What? Are you kidding me? Please tell me you are!
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
什麼？你在開玩笑吧？求求你告訴我你在開玩笑！

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
Oh wow.
You made the right call. I thought I was going to starve to death because the Laphines have no interest in pretty hats.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
哦，天哪。
你做了正確的選擇。我以為我要餓死了，因為拉菲涅斯對漂亮的帽子沒興趣。

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
I'll make it a great deal for you. You really should know I'm giving you a good deal here.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
我會給你一個超划算的價格。你應該知道我在給你優惠。

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
Is there something you had in mind? Why don't you take a look?
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
你有什麼想法嗎？不如看看這個？

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
Is ^0571B0{0}^000000 what you wanted?

[Paltu]
Ay... Credit purchases are difficult for me.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
唉...用積分購買對我來說有點困難。

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
^0571B0{0}^000000 and
^E1281E50 Splendide Coins, 4 Crystal Mirrors, 1 Fairy Magic Powder, 10 of each Emerald, Ruby, Sapphire, Topaz, and Zircon^000000 are necessary.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
需要 ^0571B0{0}^000000 和
^E1281E50 4枚輝煌領域金幣、4面水晶鏡子、1瓶妖精魔法粉，以及綠寶石、紅寶石、藍寶石、黃玉和鋯石各10顆^000000。

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
I'm in a tight spot myself. Please consider my situation also.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
我自己手頭也很緊。請體諒一下我的處境。

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
Yes, this is more than enough. Should I make it now?
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
好的，這些足夠了。我現在就開始製作嗎？

scripts.text: Please make it now.
scripts.translation: 請現在開始製作。

scripts.text: Oops, I have to take care of something...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我有點事要處理...

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
Hey.. Hey! Hey! Where you going?
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
嘿...嘿！嘿！你要去哪？

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
I got it. Oh right! Almost forgot again.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
明白了。對了！差點又忘了。

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
^FF0000In the process of replication, magic intervention phenomenon causes the hat to lose all of its refinements, cards, and hidden enchantments.^000000
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
^FF0000在複製過程中，魔法干涉現象會導致帽子失去所有的強化等級、卡片和隱藏附魔。^000000

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
^FF0000And if you possess multiple hats of the same type, the one you don't want can undergo the replication process, so please check to make sure.^000000
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
^FF0000如果您擁有多頂同類型的帽子，不想要的那頂將會被用於複製過程，請務必確認。^000000

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
So any problems with that?
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
那麼，您對此有什麼異議嗎？

scripts.text: Let me go check.
scripts.translation: 讓我去確認一下。

scripts.text: Start the replication process.
scripts.translation: 開始複製過程。

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
Yeah, please make sure!
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
是的，請務必確認！

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
Woohoo- Got it.
It's finally time for me to use my skills again.
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
耶——拿到了。
終於輪到我大顯身手了。

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
Do this thing here, and do that thing there, and then do this thing here again...
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
這裡弄一下，那裡弄一下，然後再弄一下這裡...

scripts.text:
[Paltu]
Good. This is a satisfying result.
I'll do even a better job next time. Please tell others about my work. Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[帕爾圖]
很好。這是一個令人滿意的結果。
下次我會做得更好。請把我的手藝推薦給其他人吧。祝您愉快~
